series_description.name: Prevalence of undernourishment
series_description.definition_long: Share of the population whose habitual food consumption is insufficient to provide the dietary energy levels required to maintain a normal active and healthy life. Three-year average.

sources.name: Food balance sheets and household budget survey

series_description.citation_requirement: National Statistics Office (example), Prevalence of undernourishment (FS_UNDERNOURISH_PCT), release of 2025-03-14.

series_description.name: Net enrolment rate in primary education
series_description.definition_long: Children of official primary school age who are enrolled in primary education as a share of the population of that age group.
series_description.citation_requirement: National Statistics Office (example), Net enrolment rate in primary education (ED_PRIMARY_NER_PCT), release of 2025-02-01.

series_description.name: Under-five mortality rate
series_description.definition_long: Probability that a child born in a given year dies before reaching age five. Expressed per 1000 live births.
series_description.citation_requirement: National Statistics Office (example), Under-five mortality rate (HE_U5_MORT_RATE), release of 2022-11-30.

series_description.name: Poverty headcount ratio at national poverty line
series_description.definition_long: Share of the population living below the national poverty line. Based on household consumption per adult equivalent.
series_description.citation_requirement: National Statistics Office (example), Poverty headcount ratio at national poverty line (PV_HEADCOUNT_NPL_PCT), release of 2023-06-10.
